final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias: diode-connected sink for the 10uA reference
MB  ibias ibias vss  vss nfet W=2.81191  L=2.09856
* tail current source (mirror ratio Wt/Wd)
MT  tail  ibias vss  vss nfet W=2.2132  L=2.09856
* NMOS input pair (vinp on diode side -> non-inverting)
M1  n1    vinp  tail vss nfet W=23.3516 L=2.09251
M2  vout  vinn  tail vss nfet W=23.3516 L=2.09251
* PMOS mirror load
M3  n1    n1    vdd  vdd pfet W=13.1972  L=1.5939
M4  vout  n1    vdd  vdd pfet W=13.1972  L=1.5939
* optional extra output capacitance
CC  vout  vss 1.0202e-13
.ends dut
